- **Melekh Bemishpat (s146–s151):** 26 clear mismatches with the print, listed under `issues` with band and row. Examples: `רִנָּן נַעֲרָץ` instead of the printed `רֶנֶן בְּעֶרֶץ`, a doubled `לְמַעְלָה` on s150, and many wrong prefixes and vowels. There are so many that the Hebrew looks as though it came from another edition, so the whole siluq needs a re-proof against the print. Six more readings need a human to check on enlarged images; their positions are under `unresolved`.
- **Kaddish (s160):** `מִכָּל־בִּרְכָתָא` should be `מִן־כָּל־בִּרְכָתָא`, and five printed commas are missing or replaced.
- **English note on s149:** it stops mid-sentence at "…are" at the bottom of the page. I couldn't find the English page that continues it, so I've left it unapproved without claiming the rest is missing from the book.

The existing human decisions on s148 and s151 are encoded exactly and I didn't reopen them. Alignment and milestone structure pass in all three witnesses. I didn't run any schema, compiler or refdb tests.
